items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, p20 used for 1 µL and p300 for 50 µL, labware loaded as specified, wells not overfilled; simulator passed all checks.
Fresh tip picked up and dropped for each plasmid and each SOC addition; tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks passed.
Adds an invented 3x5 µL mix after DNA addition (paper specifies none), sets lid to 42 C arbitrarily, and goes 42 C directly to 37 C, so it is not fully faithful.
Block set to 4 C, then p20 aspirates 1 µL from plasmid_plate[w] and dispenses into tc_plate[w] for A1–H1 with a fresh tip each.
Lid closed, then set_block_temperature(4, hold_time_minutes=30) followed by set_block_temperature(42, hold_time_seconds=30) on the thermocycler.
p300 dispenses 50 µL SOC into each well after the shock, lid closed, then set_block_temperature(37, hold_time_minutes=60).

judge.summary: The protocol runs correctly on the thermocycler with the right volumes, temperatures, times and tip handling, and all measured checks passed. It fails the all-or-nothing fidelity item because it adds an unrequested mixing step and an arbitrary 42 C lid setting that the paper does not specify.
